evidence.note: STACK distinguishes two distinct sources of overthinking redundancy -- 'hesitation states' (uncertainty needing correction) versus overlong-but-confident reasoning -- detecting the former via a local-entropy spike relative to a sliding-window baseline and fixing it with retrieval-augmented knowledge-guided contrastive decoding, and the latter with a self-prompted compression instruction plus an answer-convergence-based early-stopping signal, trained via a reward-difference-driven PPO+DPO hybrid loss -- cutting average response length 59.9% while improving accuracy 4.8 points over existing CoT-compression baselines on three math benchmarks.
evidence.title: Think Less, Know More: State-Aware Reasoning Compression with Knowledge Guidance for Efficient Reasoning
